introHtml: Heat transfer decoration on cooling sport towels delivers crisp, full-color logos that stand up to repeated use and washing. This method works especially well for intricate designs, gradients, or photographic images on the smooth microfiber surface of cooling towels. Ideal for corporate fitness challenges, summer safety kits, or promotional giveaways at sporting events, these towels combine functional cooling technology with vibrant branding that won't peel or fade quickly.
